Skin care |country =[[United States of America]] |related =[[Watoga Underground]] }} '''Jooky Hair Salon''' is a [[Pre-War companies|pre-War company]] and [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] within the [[Watoga Underground]] complex in [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== A hair and skin care facility in the Watoga complex, serving the clientele of the parking structure before the [[Great War|war]]. The administrative terminal describes the purpose of the company as more than a hair salon, and that "it's therapy, it's spiritual guidance, it's a chance to shape hearts and minds in our hair journey together."[[Watoga Underground terminal entries#No-Show policy|Watoga Underground terminal entries; Salon terminal, No-Show policy]] The terminal continues to outline no-show policies and product sales pitch guidelines. ==Products== Alongside strict guidelines not to sell products featured in the previous month, the administration instructed employees on how to best sell current items, including mandates to naturally insert the products into conversation with clients and what adjectives to use while describing them.[[Watoga Underground terminal entries#New Products|Watoga Underground terminal entries; Salon terminal, New Products]] * {{linkable|JOOKY cranberry face peel}} - key terms include "refreshing" "delightful" "inorganic" and "gluten free" * {{linkable|PROCLAIM hair color products}} - key terms include "vibrant" "transmogrifying" and "divine" * {{linkable|SHASBO facial massage system}} - key terms include "clever" "inspired" and "vibrational" ==Layout== * In the [[Watoga Underground]], within the commercial area between garages A and B. ==Appearances== Jooky Hair Salon appears in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==References== {{references}} {{Navbox pre-War companies}} [[Category:Pre-War companies]] [[Category:Watoga]]
